old_findings.note: The setTargetFunctionRole selector now prints with whole bytes (P6 42 -> 0). The onlyAuthorized prologue and the selector loop printed three times are unchanged.

regressions.decompiled: if not uint48(stor2[sha3(caller, _param1, 96, cd[_param2 + 4], call.data[_param2 + 36 len cd[_param2 + 4]], Bytes(ceil32(cd[_param2 + 4]) - cd[_param2 + 4], 0))].field_0): ... (the same sha3 at 10 lines in schedule, 15 in execute)
regressions.old: _94 = sha3(mem[_92 + 32 len mem[_92]]) / if not uint48(stor2[sha3(mem[_92 + 32 len mem[_92]])].field_0) ... revert/log/return with _94
regressions.source: AccessManager.hashOperation(caller, target, data) = keccak256(abi.encode(caller, target, data))
regressions.issue: The operation id is now resolved to its content, which is better, but the variable that held it (_94, _147) was dropped. So a 150-character hash is repeated at every storage access, revert, log and return, and lines over 240 characters went from 16 to 20.
regressions.rule: Bind a non-trivial expression used more than twice to one variable at its first use (keep _94 = sha3(caller, _param1, 96, ...)) and print the variable at the other uses.

improvements: The operation-id hash shows its fields (caller, target, data) instead of a memory slice. schedule's AccessManagerAlreadyScheduled revert is decoded (revert with 0x813e9459, id), its OperationScheduled log shows _90, caller, _param1, and it returns (id, nonce) as values. Hash scratch writes are dropped, and P6 42 -> 0.
notes: Diff of 868 lines, 13 functions; most hunks are only the whole-byte hex display (compared after normalizing hex). Real changes are in multicall (the result-encoding loop renamed, same structure), schedule and execute. whiles, calls, logs, requires and reverts are equal in number in every function, and both source loops are unchanged. execute's custom-error reverts (0x6dfcc650, 0x60a299b0, ...) are still raw memory, now as 'from _145 + ceil32(_data.length) + 160 len _144 - _145 + 68', where _144 and _145 both read mem[64] with no store in between (unfolded, as raw as before).
summary: One low regression: the resolved operation-id hash is repeated at every use instead of held in a variable. Otherwise schedule's revert, log and return are decoded and the selector constants print with whole bytes.
